title.en: Transferring the Philippine Textile Research Institute From the National Science Development Board to the Ministry of Industry
title.orig: Transferring the Philippine Textile Research Institute From the National Science Development Board to the Ministry of Industry

text.en:
The Philippine Textile Research Institute, herein after referred to as the Institute, shall be transferred
from the National Science Development Board and attached to the Ministry of Industry for policy and
program coordination.
The Advisory Committee of the Institute is hereby abolished.

A Board of Trustees with seven (7) members is hereby created for the Institute and shall be composed
of the Minister of Industry as Chairman, with a representative from the NSDB, Ministry of Trade, NEDA and
three (3) from the textile industry, sector to be appointed by the Minister of Industry as members; provided
that of the first three (3) members appointed, one shall serve for three (3) years, one for two (2) years, and one
for one (1) year, respectively.

The Chairman of the Board of Trustees shall appoint with the approval of the Board, the Executive
Director of the Institute.
The Board is hereby authorized to reorganize the internal structure of the Institute.

All laws, decrees, administrative orders, proclamations and rules and regulations or parts thereof which
are inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended, or modified
accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
